Dear [Lady Brandreth](../persons.html#208),
I hope in time to accomplish meeting you and conferring about the [G F S](../others.html#23) affairs!
I have never had the specimen packet, not having been the Branch associate for Literature. I think [Miss Stanford](../persons.html#2209) has it for Winchester Country and [Miss Carey](../persons.html#2210) for the City

Yours sincerely
C.M.

Yonge
